❯ [butchr] BUTCHR-316: your PR's review state changed pr:none → pr:open. Before merging,
  verify the last decisive review's own reviews[].commit.oid against your current head — an
  approval is recorded against a sha, and the branch may have moved since. A mismatch is a
  real signal (don't merge); a match is not sufficient on its own: it doesn't mean nothing
  unreviewed landed (a clean base-merge brings in main's own content, not this PR's
  reviewer's read of it), and reviews[].commit.oid can take ~30-56s to catch up after a
  base-merge, so a read taken right after your own push may just be racing that update — wait
  it out. If in doubt, ask for a re-review or point at the ticket's own [review] comment,
  pasted (never retyped) from the API — GitHub can't rewrite it, but a hand-typed one can be
  wrong; your brief has the full caveat. Act: approved → merge your own PR; changes-requested
